paragraphs: Abba bar Ḥisda — Avodah Zarah 29b. Avdimi bar Ḥisda — Zevachim 118a (according to the reading of another version). Avin bar Ḥisda, or Ravin bar Ḥisda — Gittin 5a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: נ״א is conventionally another version and qualifies Avdimi’s Zevachim reading specifically. Avin or Ravin remains an explicit alternative, not two securely distinct people or an added Rav title. Abba is explicit, with no separate rabbinic title added. The collection establishes no single father identity.
כט:/קיח./ה. give Avodah Zarah 29b/Zevachim 118a/Gittin 5a by convention; machine מט: differs from supplied כט:, without fresh image check or verified edition.
